acceptance: PERF-01: environment, CPU pinning, load, commit, binary hashes and noise caveat are recorded.
PERF-02: VM and RegVM are compared end-to-end on arithmetic, collections, fields, recursion and strings, with fallback documented.
PERF-11: Wasm compile/run timings are recorded and unsupported workloads are named with AIPO_COMPILE_WASM_UNSUPPORTED.
PERF-12: available cross-language runtimes (Aipo, Python, Node, Rust) are compared; unavailable runtimes are recorded as unavailable.
Raw JSON evidence and a human-readable matrix are committed under docs/evidence/P08-G01/.
Documentation links the new baseline and states that this is not a dedicated runner.
constraints: Do not claim a dedicated-runner baseline; record the shared-host limitation.
Do not hide the Wasm unsupported workload or unavailable reference runtimes.
Do not use the measurements as a regression gate without a dedicated environment.
non_goals: Temporal regression gating on shared CI runners.
Installing every optional reference runtime in this round.
Optimizing any backend in this goal.
objective: Execute and record PERF-01, PERF-02, PERF-11 and PERF-12 on the best available isolated CPU, with reproducible data and explicit limits.
title: Performance Matrix 2 baseline
